description: Graded Prognostic Assessment (GPA) for brain metastases. Takes clinical variables (age, Karnofsky performance status, number of CNS metastases, extracranial metastases) as CSV and returns the 0-4 GPA score, a prognostic category, and estimated median survival in months. Deterministic index (Sperduto 2008). Can consume metastasis count forwarded from a brain-metastasis detection model.
disease: brain metastases, brain metastasis, metastatic brain tumor, prognosis, survival
